tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark is the primary theme: a true neutral near-black with no blue cast.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, the setup rail.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised rows, hover, table headers, inputs.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panels and rows. Borders, not shadows, separate surfaces.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control outlines (secondary button, inputs) — 3:1 on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and the background dot grid. Decorative only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, axis labels — ≥4.5:1 on bg and surface-1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lens indigo. Primary button fill, selected options, the current step and the APILens mark. One solid fill per view region, never a gradient. White text on it is 5.4:1.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text, links, focus rings and thin strokes. ≥4.5:1 on bg and surface-1 in both themes.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (4.8:1 on accent).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy, connected, done. Good news uses the brand indigo; problems use amber and red. Healthy items in lists stay grey.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Degraded / slow / 4xx spikes.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Down / 5xx / failed checks. Never decorative.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral data series (p50, throughput) and heads-up notes. A quiet slate in dark mode and a soft blue in light, so it never competes with status.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind ok text, checkmarks and newly added items.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Badge ground behind warn text.

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Badge ground behind error text.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Page titles in setup and settings.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Lead paragraph under a page title, ≤ 60ch, ink-muted.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: KPI values. Numbers are always mono so digits don't jump as they update.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside badges and button groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, small card gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), grid gutters in the dashboard.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (default), gaps between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between a headline block and its CTAs.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between a page title block and the content below it.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Outer padding on full-page layouts.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small inputs, chart tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, KPI cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels and option cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips and toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-frame
tokens.usage: Only on floating panels (⌘K switcher, popovers). Everything else uses borders.
